symbols.name: POST
symbols.sig: export async function POST( request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },)
doc: Returns the UNMASKED value of one field of one employee (mobile, e-mail, SAIL P.No., ticket number) AND writes an audit row recording who revealed it (viewer ticket), the viewer's IP, and the time (the field is logged as mobile, email, sailpno or ticket). Login-gated. The P.No. is also the first password, so I gave its reveals a cap of their own (src/lib/security/revealCap.ts).
